children: Colombian financial holding company Grupo SURA (SIS.CN) raised its net profit projection range for this year to between 2.5 trillion pesos ($805.09 million) and 2.7 trillion pesos ($869.50 million), up from a previous range of between 2.3 trillion and 2.5 trillion pesos, CEO Ricardo Jaramillo told Reuters on Wednesday, while ruling out financial risks stemming from August's earthquake.
The executive also estimated that the firm's net profit would reach around 3 trillion pesos in 2027, climbing to 3.3 trillion pesos in 2028.

Jaramillo said the deadly earthquake could have a temporary impact on Grupo SURA because the company may need to cover some claims payments before recovering funds from reinsurers, but it would not pose a risk to the holding company's fundamentals.

title: Colombia's Grupo SURA sees higher net profit, rules out long-term earthquake impact
